title: Revolutionizing Distance Learning: AI-Driven Personalization for the Next-Gen Education System
content: Distance education plays an important role in education by making it flexible for students from various backgrounds. This is especially true in a country like India, where the diversity of and access to education differ widely. In this paper, we present an AI-based recommendation system that surveys the candidate's academic history, such as grades obtained, learning preferences, and course modes, so as to recommend the most suitable class, subject, and style of study. Using forecasting algorithms and rule-based inference, it is able to provide personalized, data-driven suggestions to a large number of students. It considers major factors such as previous academic performance, institutional regulations, and access limitations to improve decision-making in distance learning. In addition, it makes use of natural language processing (NLP) for interactive student mentoring and for explaining recommendations. It aims to bridge the gap between students and the best learning alternatives in order to create more effective and efficient distance education in India.
